text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: ――――Haaaaahhh---...!!

Passing by the training track after wrapping
up work,
I saw Red Desire running.
I couldn't tear my eyes away from her...

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
—Oh, there is someone there.
Do you hold an interest...
in the stride of a saint?
choice_data_list: Ah, yeah... You're working hard pr...
Ah, yeah... You're working hard pr...

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Hehe.
To confront these trials,
daytime discipline alone will not suffice.
choice_data_list: Um... would you mind if I watched ...

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Yes, by all means.
Please,
bear witness to the struggles of the Saint
Desire.

To my surprise,
she devoted herself earnestly to her
regimen.
Her methods were remarkably grounded and
straightforward—unlike her usual persona.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Phew...! Not yet, I will not falter...
I must hone my strength further...
or I shall never reach the Otherworld!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
My goodness...! You heard that?
Ah, hearing such words must naturally arouse
one's curiosity.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Can the mysteries of a saint truly not remain
concealed?
...Very well,
this too is destiny.
I shall confide in you—

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
In truth,
I received a divine revelation when I was
small.
That I am a saint destined to reincarnate
and become the savior of an Otherworld.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
However, in order to reach that realm,
I must overcome countless trials and gather
radiance.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
And the greatest trial bestowed upon me...
is racing!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Racing is the path through which I shine
brightest,
yet also the thorny path of hardship.
Ah... how could this be anything but fate?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
In other words...
by prevailing in races here and gathering
radiance,
I shall at last arrive in the Otherworld!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Yes... In a place far beyond this world,
I will become more special than anyone
else...

The next day, for some reason,
Red Desire was doing tandem runs
alongside horsegirls aiming for dirt racing.
It wasn't her usual training menu.
choice_data_list: Are you considering dirt races too...?
Are you considering dirt races too...?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
No, it is simply...
that I am confronting various hardships
right now.
For one never knows where the trials summoning
a saint may lie asleep.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
That concludes my on-campus training for
today.
I must take my leave now,
as I am heading out.

Was she going to continue training somewhere
off-campus?
I couldn't help wondering what she was up
to next.
choice_data_list: Um, do you mind if I come along?

text_block_list.name: Rough Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
Huhhh?
What's some Tracen Academy missy doing here,
huh?!
We don't got no nicely groomed turf tracks
around this place!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
I felt called... to this very place.
This untrodden ground might be the exact
trial I must overcome!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Please, grant me a match against you.
A saint fears no adversity! Come!

text_block_list.name: Rough Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
Wh-whoa...?
What's this chick babbling about?
Whoa...! Argh, fine, I get it already!

Red Desire tore past with astounding
speed.
Running like this on unfamiliar terrain...
her skill was undeniably real.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
—Ngh!
This is completely different from the
academy's tracks...
Racing on this ground is truly demanding in
its own right.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Even so! I will overcome it...!
And claim the radiance that lies beyond this
trial—!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
I have done it...!
It appears I have gathered yet another spark
of radiance.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
The Otherworld remains far away...
Yet I feel I have drawn one step
closer...!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Though we call it simply 'racing,' horsegirls
hold manifold possibilities.
The place where each gathers radiance is
unique to them...

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
That is why one must seek out their destined
path.
And overcome the trials that stand in their
way...
choice_data_list: So that's why you're trying out al...

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... The saint is being tested.
Though in the terms of this world,
I suppose that is what it amounts to.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
I am certain of it.
When I overcome every trial and gather the
radiance,
I will reach the place where I truly belong...
the 'Otherworld.'

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
And not only myself as a saint.
...Everyone walks their own destined path
in much the same way.

I was beginning to understand how Red Desire's
mind worked.
It seemed she was simply searching for the
place where she belonged...

Dedicating herself so earnestly,
trying out so many things...
Aiming for something like an 'Otherworld'...
In other words...
choice_data_list: Does she just want to be 'special'...

text_block_list.text:
I understood the sentiment all too well.
Back in middle school, I used to
dream about becoming the 'Ultimate Trainer'
who conquered everything—

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
The prodigy Trainer <username>!
Another miraculous triumph!
Following the Triple Crown sweep,
they've finally conquered the Breeders'
Cup---!

Yet, those delusions faded as I grew up.
Realizing I was just 'ordinary,' I learned
to make peace with reality...

No matter how talented she was,
she would eventually wake from unattainable
dreams.
It was a growing pain everyone experienced.
But the stronger the belief,
the sharper the pain.

If that day ever comes,
what will happen to her...?
Presumptuous as it was,
I couldn't help feeling worried.
